description: Checks at session start that gooze and goozels are installed and up to date (Go projects only), and after Claude edits a Go file or gooze.yaml adds goozels' gooze diagnostics to its context. Silent when there is nothing to report.

args: case "$(goozels version </dev/null 2>/dev/null)" in goozels*) exec goozels hook claude;; esac; exit 0
